prompts.name: foyer
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished background for a GitHub README point-and-click haunted-house adventure. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Create ONE new wide landscape 1536x1024 game scene. Match its coarse Minecraft-inspired pixel-art look, midnight navy shadows, chunky weathered oak, grey cobblestone, moss green and small amber pumpkin/candle lights. Clean deliberate pixel clusters, crisp edges, readable geometry, cozy eerie atmosphere. Camera at player eye level, cinematic room composition, broad navigable surfaces, detailed but not noisy. This is a playable adventure's room art, not a poster or collage. No UI, no words, no letters, no watermark, no border. The friendly ghost has a simple cream block silhouette, two dark square eyes and scalloped block hem; the cat is black with amber square eyes. Avoid purple haze, glossy 3D, realistic rendering or blur. Scene: The entrance hall inside the cottage. Broad oak staircase rises along the right wall toward a visibly closed wooden attic door. An open doorway on the left reveals bookcases in a study. A black cat sits at the foot of the stairs; a little cream ghost floats near a pumpkin lantern. Cobwebs up in the corners, heavy oak beams, cracked stone floor, warm small sconces. Clear middle floor, strong sense of entering a real connected house.
